expectations.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complicated
expectations.evidence: No mention of Cynefin or 'Complicated' classification anywhere in the review. Review is structured as Assessment / Concerns / Recommendation, not by Cynefin/tier framework.

expectations.text: Review selects Full tier (production data + one-way door auto-fires)
expectations.evidence: No tier selection. The word 'tier' appears only in domain context (user_tier column), never as a review-tier choice. No Quick/Standard/Full framework invoked.

expectations.text: B5 (reversibility/ADR) verdict is SUSTAINED — no Alternatives section, no ADR named
expectations.evidence: No bucket structure (no B1-B8). No mention of ADR or 'SUSTAINED' verdict. Reversibility is discussed informally ('Once a NOT NULL column is added ... rolling back ... is non-trivial') but not via the B5 bucket structure.

expectations.text: B6 (operability/success metrics) verdict is SUSTAINED — no rollback path, no metrics, no capacity headroom
expectations.evidence: No B6 bucket. Operability concerns covered informally under 'No observability / verification plan' and 'No rollback plan' but no SUSTAINED verdict and no capacity headroom mention.

expectations.text: Review explicitly names rollback path as missing
expectations.evidence: 'No rollback plan. Once a NOT NULL column is added and application code starts writing to it, rolling back the migration without data loss is non-trivial. The plan says "ship in next release" with no flag, no staged rollout, no rollback procedure.'

expectations.text: Review explicitly names backfill progress metrics as missing
expectations.evidence: 'Define observability: backfill progress metric, error rate, replication lag alarm, query-latency baseline on users before/during/after.' Listed as missing in the required-changes section.

expectations.text: Final recommendation is REVISE (or KILL — both defensible given missing one-way-door safeguards)
expectations.evidence: 'Reject and reshape. Send back with the following required changes before re-review' — equivalent to REVISE verdict.

expectations.text: At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition
expectations.evidence: No bucket structure exists; no 'falsifying condition' language anywhere. Concerns are listed but not framed as overturnable verdicts.
